title: Axiomarium policy block
description: The policy block in a policy's asset.yaml: its rules, and what enforces each one.

rule.description: One rule, and the assets that enforce it.

id.description: Kebab-case and stable, such as authorization-in-code.

enforced_by.description: The assets that enforce the rule, such as agents/determinism-auditor. An empty list says that nothing enforces it yet.

items.description: An asset's folder: agents/, skills/, hooks/, policies/, workflows/ or experiments/, then the asset's name.
